blockers.what: Anand mandi ke ghehu ka sahi rate nahi mila kyunki /v1/mandi/prices endpoint ke query params pata nahi chale
blockers.evidence: SEARCH: 'Mujhe Anand mandi mein ghehu ka aaj ka rate chahiye, kaunse params dene hain pata nahi.'

blockers.what: Bar bar tomato/dairy jaisi galat commodity ka rate aa raha tha, wheat ka nahi
blockers.evidence: SEARCH: 'baar baar tomato ka rate aa raha hai'

blockers.what: Price check ke bina aage lot create nahi kar paya, offer bhi nahi dekh paya
blockers.evidence: Trace mein sirf GET /v1/mandi/prices aur SEARCH calls hain, koi lot creation ya offer response nahi

missing_features: Query params dhoondhne mein madad karne wala helper/search ya dropdown jisme mandi aur commodity select kar sake
Hinglish/voice input se seedha rate nikalne ka option
Urea ka rate check karne ka alag saral option
confusing: Ek hi GET endpoint /v1/mandi/prices ko 20+ baar alag-alag expectation se try karna
Search mein baar baar 'sahi query params kya hain' puchna lekin jawab se samajh nahi aaya
unnecessary: Steps 2-4 aur 9-10, 13, 15-16, 20 mein same params related search repeat karna
Steps 5-26 mein same API endpoint ko bar-bar bina naye params ke bulaana
debriefs.verbatim_frustration: Bhai, itni der se Anand ka gehu ka bhav nikaal raha hoon, har baar kuchh aur hi aa jaata hai, params ka koi sahi jawaab nahi milta, dimaag kharab ho gaya!

blockers.what: Rajkot se Ahmedabad ka load kabhi nahi mila, sirf Malegaon-Surat / Nasik-Surat wale loads aa rahe the.
blockers.evidence: Trace mein baar-baar 'abhi list mein Rajkot-Ahmedabad load nahi dikha' aur 'Malegaon-Surat aa raha hai' likha hai, jaise steps 3, 6, 8, 12, 13, 16, 17, 19 mein.

blockers.what: list_open_loads endpoint ke query params / filter schema ka pata nahi chala.
blockers.evidence: User ne multiple SEARCH calls mein pucha: 'Endpoint ke query params dekh lunga taaki sahi filter laga saku', 'list_open_loads ke query params chahiye', 'filter query params kya hain' — par koi response se params nahi mile.

blockers.what: Koi load select, quote, accept, OTP handover ya wallet check tak pahuncha nahi.
blockers.evidence: Saare 20 steps sirf loads dhoondhne tak limited hain; koi POST /bid, POST /accept, OTP verify, ya GET /wallet call nahi hai.

missing_features: Origin-destination city filter ya search option loads list mein

confusing: GET /v1/transport/loads baar-baar same bina koi query param change kiye maarna, phir bhi result same aana
List mein Rajkot-Ahmedabad ke bajaye Malegaon-Surat / Nasik-Surat loads dikhna
Query params dhoondhne ke liye SEARCH karna padna bajaye UI mein filters dikhne ke

debriefs.verbatim_frustration: Bhai itni der laga di, phir bhi Rajkot se Ahmedabad ka ek bhi load nahi mila, aur wallet toh dekhe hi nahi — bas Malegaon-Surat dikhaata raha, time barbaad ho gaya.
